title: Privacy zones: RBACv2 hard-guard, KMS anchoring, and audit delta sink
author: Dana Park
description: Motivation: customers operating under strict data residency constraints asked for a first-class "privacy zone" concept that ties RBAC claims, KMS usage, and audit metadata together. This PR implements a zone-scoped RBACv2 hard-guard (policy enforcement instead of best-effort tagging), anchors KMS operations to region-pinned CMKs, and emits a compact "audit delta" sink with zone + key provenance so downstream compliance tooling can prove residency and key-origin. The change is intentionally surgical: the new enforcer is pluggable and gated behind a feature flag (feature.privacy_zones.enabled) and a rolling rollout can be performed per cluster via operator config. Checklist: - Implement zone-aware policy evaluator (RBACv2) that denies requests if zone claim/key mismatch. - Add KMS anchoring middleware to annotates decrypt/encrypt calls with cmk-region and enforcement mode. - Add audit-delta sink that tags audit events with zone, cmk_origin, and enforcement_decision. - Surface policy editor in Console (read-only for GA; edit via YAML for now). - Add unit and integration tests, plus a small e2e scenario using test-kms emulator. Related: ENG-4198 (design doc), SEC-1224 (compliance signoff). Rollout notes: enable feature flag in canary region first; RBAC policy migration includes a one-time background scan that annotates tenants with inferred zone where available. For tenants without a zone, the enforcer defaults to "opt-in" behavior until tenant metadata is set. If the feature is turned on in enforcement mode, mismatches will be rejected and will surface QC alerts. Implementation details: - Enforcer lives in authorization/zone_enforcer.go and plugs into the existing RBACv2 path as an additional policy step; it evaluates the request's tenant_claims.zone, service_region and the configured policy matrix. - KMS anchoring is implemented as a proxy shim (infra/kms/anchor_proxy.py) that consults the configured cmk registry and rejects operations if the requested cmk is out-of-region for the request zone; it emits a KMS_PROVENANCE header consumed by the audit delta sink. - Audit delta sink (observability/audit_delta_sink.go) batches lightweight audit deltas (event_id, zone, cmk_origin, decision, timestamp) which are forwarded to the compliance indexer. - Console adds a new read-only "Privacy Zones" page with a per-tenant summary and policy preview. - Helm/installer additions: new values.privacyZones.* keys and operator RBAC changes for the background annotator. Migration: background annotator will run as a job (k8s) that is idempotent; rollback is safe (feature flag off => enforcement disabled). Security review notes: added extra checks in the KMS proxy to ensure authorization context is preserved; a lint-level security scanner flagged a potential header propagation gap which has been fixed. Testing: unit tests for policy behavior, integration with test-kms emulator, e2e scenario using a synthetic tenant with zone=eu-west. Signoffs: security, compliance, and infra.

review_thread: Elliot Kim: Nice high-level design. Can you clarify the interaction with existing fallback routing? If a region-pinned CMK is unavailable we should fallback to a tenant-level policy rather than a blind reject.

Author (Dana Park): We explicitly do not allow silent fallback when enforcement=true. The background annotator tries to populate tenant zone metadata to avoid surprises; fallback can be enabled via 'enforcementMode: permissive' in the helm values for a controlled roll-out.
Mariana Silva: Tests look good overall, but I saw a flaky assertion in the e2e that was failing on CI (timeout). Please replace time.Sleep with an event wait and re-run.
Author (Dana Park): Replaced with event-driven wait; pushed a small fix. CI re-run addressed the flake.

Rajesh Patel: Please add a metric for 'zone_enforcer.denied_by_zone' and an audit-level histogram for audit-delta forwarding latency. Also ensure the KMS proxy logs cmk_id with redaction at debug level.
Author (Dana Park): Added prometheus counters and an audit-latency histogram; KMS proxy logs are now redacted by default and only expose cmk fingerprint at debug.
Mariana Silva (approving): Security review complete, checked header propagation and mitigations for header spoofing. Approving pending 1 doc tweak.
Elliot Kim (approved): Approve. Recommend canary enablement in eu-west only for first week.
Repo automation (merge-bot): All required approvals present and CI green. Ready to squash-merge.

release_notes: Adds privacy zones: an RBACv2 enforcement layer that ties tenant zone claims to KMS CMK region anchors and emits compact audit deltas for compliance indexing. Feature gated and opt-in by default; migration job included. See docs/compliance/privacy-zones.md for rollout steps.
summary: Implements a privacy-zone enforcement feature that combines RBACv2 policy hard-guards, KMS region anchoring, and audit delta emission to support strict data residency and key provenance requirements. Feature-flagged and designed for incremental rollout.
